mechanics.claim: Caitlyn channels before firing; the shot only deals damage once the channel completes and the bullet hits.
mechanics.quote: Once '''Caitlyn''' completes the channel, she fires a homing bullet toward the target that deals {{as|physical damage}} to the first enemy champion it hits

mechanics.claim: The ability can be canceled by interruption, target becoming untargetable, or either party dying, and mana is not refunded if canceled.
mechanics.quote: The following will cancel ''Ace in the Hole's'' channel (mana expenditure is not compensated)

mechanics.claim: Cooldown starts on cast (i.e., at the beginning of the channel), not on the bullet landing.
The bullet deals no damage if it fails to hit the primary target because they are untargetable on arrival.
mechanics.quote: The bullet missile will fail to hit the primary target if they are {{tip|untargetable}} upon arrival, dealing no damage.

mechanics.claim: The ability can be blocked by spell shields.
